name: model-fit
description: Model Fit: checks whether the chat's model and effort fit the task, shows a Switch button above the prompt when they do not, and can switch by itself (Auto). A cheap Haiku call judges each prompt or each skill start against a model-selection rubric.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: When to look for a Mismatch: off, prompt (every prompt and every skill start) or skill (only when a skill starts)

auto.title: Auto
auto.description: Switch to the Recommendation by itself. Off: the band offers a Switch button and nothing changes until you press it

guardTokens.title: Cache guard (tokens)
guardTokens.description: Above this context size no cheaper model is recommended, because /model drops the prompt cache. Lowering effort stays allowed

models.title: Models
models.description: Comma-separated models it may recommend: haiku, sonnet, opus

efforts.title: Efforts
efforts.description: Comma-separated effort levels it may recommend: low, medium, high, xhigh

rubricFile.title: Rubric file
rubricFile.description: Path of a Markdown file that replaces the built-in model-selection rules the Judge follows. Empty: the built-in rules
